capabilities: Render the active note to PDF using publishing profiles (session sheet, book, booklet, two-column variants)
Impose A5 pages onto A4 landscape sheets for duplex printing and saddle stitching
Turn every level-one heading into an A6 landscape index card in one PDF
Steer print layout with Markdown hints like page breaks, wide images, and frontmatter titles
Write output to a configurable publishing/output folder
extras: Desktop-only in the initial release; installable via BRAT until listed in the community directory; templates and typography are intentionally not configurable; all compilation and booklet imposition run locally and offline.
problem: Obsidian can export to PDF but offers no control over print layouts such as two-column sheets, imposed booklets, or per-heading index cards.

relations.evidence: Until the plugin is available in Obsidian's community directory, install it with BRAT

summary: Print-layout tool that renders Markdown notes into session sheets, books, booklets, and index cards using a bundled Typst compiler.
